title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode6 For A Show Filled with Cherry Blossoms

meta.Episode: Episode6 — For A Show Filled with Cherry Blossoms
meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, are the cherry blossom petals ready?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, all set!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're ready too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's make it rain cherry blossoms☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That basket's huge.
Are you sure you're gonna be able to shake it with this rope?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Just leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, that basket is quite big.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Tsukasa seemed adamant about having a blizzard of cherry blossom petals, so I went ahead and made said basket.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
Hehe. This effect should match this season perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Lots and lots of petals!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, the more the merrier!
But we'll need to time it right for it to look good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So without further ado... Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Behold!
This might of the King of Spring!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here we go☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wafty-wafty-waft♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is fantastic...!
They look like real cherry blossoms!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
It's so cute and pretty... And specially wonderhoooy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Indeed!
It's as picturesque as I expected it to be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I have a feeling they can fall a bit more gracefully like actual flower petals...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You think so?
They seem pretty enough as it is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate the compliment, but something about them doesn't seem real...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Isn't there a way to make them thinner so that they float better while bringing out more of the sheen real petals have?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, lighter and more vibrant?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I think it'd look even more fantastic if they floated gracefully in this spring sun and breeze instead of just falling to the ground.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure what we can do since they just aren't the real deal...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, what if we had a cherry blossom tree join in on the fun? It could waltz on over by using its roots as feet!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A walking cherry blossom tree?!
Haha. I have to say, MEIKO, your ideas are never dull.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I like her idea.
It'd be so nice to take a nap underneath a cherry blossom tree♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
I bet you'd see a really amazing dream too☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What happened to our original problem...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But a real cherry blossom tree...
I'm not sure I've seen one around here before...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm back!
Oh, I know! What if we looked for a cherry blossom tree together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I haven't seen real cherry blossoms before, but I've seen lots and lots of flowers♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
There are plenty of flowers here in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Flower
rows.Line: Then, why don't you try using our petals?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! No, we couldn't!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds a bit...
Anyway, we appreciate the thought.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! I have a great idea!
If there aren't any cherry blossoms over here, we can just bring some over from our side!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, actual cherry blossoms...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! There's a giant cherry blossom tree at my house in the garden, so why don't we gather some of its fallen petals and bring them over here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I was sure you were thinking about bringing a whole tree over...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Same...
It's much more practical compared to your usual ideas, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heehee!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa! We get to see real cherry blossoms?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna see too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's go gather up some petals!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Woohoo! I can't wait to see them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! It's gonna be super duper exciting and wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll head over to start gathering those petals.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆ Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They're always bringing us such fun and interesting things over to SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Miku, Len, myself and the others...
We're all able to put on fun shows because of them.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do to repay them somehow...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
They'd probably appreciate something that has to do with shows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, since we're using cherry blossom petals during our next show, I could try looking for some real ones in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm yet to see any, but maybe I'll find some if I take a closer look.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... This forest seems like the most probable spot...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Look, it's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They'll probably love it if you give it to them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Why are all the plushies in a circle like that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello there!
What are you all up to?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Hey, it's KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Busted!!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Aww... That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What's too bad?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: We just found this really pretty thing just now!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's so shiny and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: We were thinking about giving it to you guys as a present too...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: But you ended up finding us first...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, is that what this is about?
I can say for a fact that I'm very happy to hear such kind words.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
Miku and the others still don't know yet, so why don't we hand it to them together?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
By the way, what exactly did you find?
Mind if I see how pretty it is?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Sure! Here, hold your hand out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, like this?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Ta-daa!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, is that a...?!
